component.name: Open-SSTV
component.summary: Send and receive slow-scan television images over amateur radio

description.p: Open-SSTV transmits and decodes slow-scan television (SSTV), the picture mode amateur radio operators use to exchange images on HF and VHF. It runs on Linux, macOS and Windows, and it can key your radio over CAT or Hamlib's rigctld.

ul.li: 22 modes, including Robot 36, Martin, Scottie, PD, Wraase and Pasokon
Live decoding with a waterfall, plus decoding of recorded WAV files
Transmit templates with callsign, report and QSO overlays
A built-in logbook with ADIF import and export
An image gallery of everything sent and received
Remote operation from a phone or tablet browser
